Class MCTS

java.lang.Object
MCTS
public class MCTS extends Object
Monte Carlo Tree Search for a two-player zero-sum game (Problem 3, Tic-Tac-Toe).

The algorithm is kept apart from the game, following the Lab 1 pattern: it only talks to the game through Ilayout. Each call to chooseMove(Ilayout) builds a search tree rooted at the given state and repeats four phases: selection, expansion, simulation and backpropagation.

MAX is the player to move at the root. Every statistic w is counted from MAX's point of view (win 1, draw 0.5, loss 0), so MAX nodes maximise the upper confidence bound w/n + c*sqrt(ln(t)/n) and MIN nodes minimise the lower bound w/n - c*sqrt(ln(t)/n). The move returned is the root child that was visited the most.

  • Constructor Details

    • MCTS

      public MCTS(int iterations, double c, long seed)
      Creates a search with a fixed budget.
      Parameters:
      iterations - number of iterations (selection + expansion + simulations + backpropagation) per move
      c - exploration constant of the tree policy
      seed - seed of the random generator used by the simulations (same seed, same move)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if iterations <= 0 or c is negative or NaN

  • Method Details

    • chooseMove

      public int chooseMove(Ilayout state)
      Searches from state and returns the cell the player to move should play. The state is never modified; the search works on the copies returned by children().
      Parameters:
      state - the current game state
      Returns:
      the cell of the most visited child of the root
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the game is already over

    • scoreMax

      private double scoreMax(Ilayout gameFinished)
      Converts the result of a finished game into a value from MAX's point of view.
      Parameters:
      gameFinished - a terminal state
      Returns:
      1 if MAX won, 0.5 for a draw, 0 if MAX lost

    • selectMove

      private MCTS.Node selectMove(MCTS.Node node)
      Selection: descends from node choosing a child with bestChild(Node) until a leaf.
      Parameters:
      node - where the descent starts (the root)
      Returns:
      the leaf that was reached

    • bestChild

      MCTS.Node bestChild(MCTS.Node parent)
      Tree policy: picks the child of parent to follow. A child that was never visited goes first. Otherwise a MAX parent maximises w/n + c*sqrt(ln(t)/n) and a MIN parent minimises w/n - c*sqrt(ln(t)/n), which is done by maximising -w/n + c*sqrt(ln(t)/n). Ties keep the first child.
      Parameters:
      parent - a node that already has children
      Returns:
      the chosen child

    • movePlayed

      private int movePlayed(Ilayout parent, Ilayout child)
      Finds the cell played to go from parent to child: the only free cell of the parent that is no longer free in the child (Ilayout is not extended for this).
      Parameters:
      parent - a state
      child - one of the successors of parent
      Returns:
      the cell that was played

    • expandLeaf

      private void expandLeaf(MCTS.Node leaf)
      Expansion: creates one child for every successor of the leaf, in the order of children().
      Parameters:
      leaf - a non-terminal node without children

    • simulation

      private Ilayout simulation(Ilayout start, Random random)
      Simulation (rollout): plays random legal moves from start until the game ends. start is not modified.
      Parameters:
      start - the state where the rollout begins
      random - source of the random choices
      Returns:
      the terminal state reached (start itself if it is already terminal)

    • backPropagation

      private void backPropagation(MCTS.Node node, double result)
      Backpropagation: adds one visit and result to every node from node up to the root. The result is always from MAX's point of view, so it is not inverted at MIN levels.
      Parameters:
      node - where the simulation (or terminal evaluation) happened
      result - value from MAX's point of view, see scoreMax(Ilayout)

    • mostVisitedNode

      private MCTS.Node mostVisitedNode(MCTS.Node root)
      Move decision: the child of the root with the most visits. On a tie the higher w wins (same n, so a higher win rate), and then the first child.
      Parameters:
      root - a root that has children
      Returns:
      the chosen child
